rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=6, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, n_iter=400, outer_wall_s=1200, lr=0.0023, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=7, proj_kernel=7, img_kernel=5, proj_sx=1.0, proj_sy=2.0, proj_sr=0.05, img_sx=1.5, img_sy=1.5, img_sr=0.02, rationale=iter-11: ONE knob changed vs the iter-6 hr-0.4222 PEAK base (proj_sr 0.02->0.05, the PROJECTION-domain bilateral RANGE sigma); all 18 other fields held IDENTICAL to demo_dl_dual_domain_bilateral_n2i_iter_06.json (img_n_bf=7, img_sr=0.02 LOOSE demo-correct, proj_n_bf=1, proj_k=7/img_k=5, proj_sx/sy=1.0/2.0, img_sx/sy=1.5/1.5, lr=2.3e-3, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, n_iter=400, train_n=200, val_n=6, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42 -> identical seed=42 val split, directly comparable to iter-6 hr 0.3330 / PSNR 20.18 / SSIM 0.7796). PROBE A PROJECTION-DOMAIN KNOB IN THE LOOSE DIRECTION -- the only proven-safe direction on demo and the one axis never touched at the PEAK. Read iters 9->10 BY HEADROOM (campaign primary, PSNR/noise-sensitive on demo): iter-9 val_n 6->12 at seed=123 CONFIRMED hr~0.41 is REAL (0.4099, PSNR 18.61) -- not a lucky 6-scene draw; iter-10 pretrain_epochs 3->6 DEAD FLAT (hr 0.3328, PSNR ~iter-6) -> the warm-start amortized anchor is already SATURATED at 3 epochs. FAILURE MODE at hr~0.42: the 6-param bilateral sits at its structural noise-floor ceiling on the 64-view (half of 128) FBP, and EVERY image-side + anchor lever is now EXHAUSTED: image-domain DEPTH (img_n_bf, hr slope collapsed to ~0 by n_bf=5: 1->3 +0.051, 3->5 +0.006, 5->7 +0.000), per-scan OPTIMIZER budget (n_iter flat 400->800; the 6-param BF physically CANNOT overfit one scan), warm-start anchor length (pretrain_epochs flat 3->6). img_sr is EXHAUSTED + substrate-confirmed WRONG-direction (demo wants LOOSE 0.02; tightening to 0.0005 collapsed hr 0.3335->0.1998 at iter-4 -- do NOT repeat). What has NEVER been perturbed at the PEAK is the PROJECTION-domain stack. The standing claim (design doc + mayo_campaign_state.md) is that the proj stack is in a 'symmetry trap' -> proj_n_bf stays 1, wasted params. BUT that claim was only ever tested via proj_n_bf DEPTH (stacking more near-identity filters) -- the proj RANGE sigma itself was pinned at proj_sr=0.02 the entire run. A single near-identity proj BF at proj_sr=0.02 behaves almost as a pass-through in the sinogram domain (range kernel too tight to act on the noisy 64-view sinogram), which is PRECISELY why stacking it (proj_n_bf>1) is wasted. HYPOTHESIS (proj-range): LOOSENING proj_sr 0.02->0.05 widens the single proj BF range kernel so it actually smooths sinogram-domain noise BEFORE the FBP adjoint (a denoising axis ORTHOGONAL to the exhausted image-domain levers), giving the dual-domain pipeline genuine projection-domain denoising it has lacked -> lifts hr/PSNR above the iter-6 ~0.333 / PSNR 20.18 baseline on the SAME seed=42 split. Direction is LOOSE (demo confirmed-correct direction; mirrors the image-domain finding that demo wants LOOSE range sigma) -- the OPPOSITE of the forbidden img_sr tightening. If hr/PSNR stay FLAT, it CONFIRMS the proj stack is genuinely structurally inert on this 128-view phantom substrate even with a loosened range kernel (the symmetry-trap claim holds for the RANGE axis too, not just depth) and the ~hr 0.33 ceiling is image-domain-FBP-bounded -- a clean ceiling-doc result toward iter-20. Chose proj_sr (LOOSE) over (a) img_n_bf/n_iter/pretrain_epochs (all DEAD FLAT, exhausted), (b) img_sr (exhausted + WRONG-direction -- forbidden), (c) proj_n_bf depth (symmetry trap -- stacking a near-identity filter is the wasted-param move; loosening the SINGLE filter range is the un-tested alternative), (d) grad_clip (mandatory overflow guard at 1.0, not a quality lever). Held fixed at iter-6 PEAK values: img_n_bf=7, img_sr=0.02 (LOOSE, demo-correct), proj_n_bf=1, kernels (proj_k=7/img_k=5), proj_sx=1.0/proj_sy=2.0, img_sx=1.5/img_sy=1.5, lr=2.3e-3, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, n_iter=400, train_n=200, val_n=6, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42. Wall: iter-6 ran 828 s; proj_sr is a pure init value with ZERO added compute, so wall ~unchanged, comfortably under the 1800 s sbatch wall and the 1200 s outer_wall_s internal guard (under the 15-min budget). PER-IMAGE bilateral N2I, AGENT4CT_DATASET=phantoms; warm_start STAYS ON; do NOT revert to amortized.
